Class PlayerManager

java.lang.Object
PlayerManager
public class PlayerManager extends Object
Jean Roudy Alexis CEN - 3024C - 23585 - Software Development 1 April 3, 2026 PlayerManager.java This class manages soccer player data storage, retrieval, updates, and deletion using a MySQL database. It serves as the connection between the GUI and the database layer.
